Subjective provisional scores for observed emulated portrait experience, not win/loss grades or a physical-phone certification.

reasons.overallMobile: Coherent atmospheric mission with clear progression and helpful touch assists, offset by small targets, crowded controls and uncertain moving-target feedback. Two assisted wins do not establish broad combat depth or continuous enjoyment.
reasons.controls: Large anchored FIRE and MOVE areas, scene turning, DASH and zoom all responded in brief samples. Small targets required tap assistance; moving edge target burst was hard to interpret. Fine precision, long dual-thumb sessions and most tools remain unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery, coil exposure and upload provide understandable staged goals. Rear threats and shield loss created pressure. In these assisted paused runs I could travel past many threats, so sustained challenge, tactical depth and broader replay value are unproven.
reasons.presentation: Strong teal/amber visual language, rain, industrial geometry, cohesive title and terminal screens. Dark cover and tiny enemies can blend into the scene. Audio not assessed.
reasons.usability: Useful handbook, adaptive route/approach/recover labels, planning map with clear close button, objective confirmations, and detailed assist statistics. Several simultaneous banners and lower control clusters compete for attention.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo, objective and upload meter readable at 390x844. World signs, distant enemies, small status text and dense handbook require more attention; short labels wrap across cramped buttons.
